name: gmail-followup
description: Use the Gmail Follow-Up Tool from Claude: write and send campaigns with follow-ups and attachments, create sequences, start follow-ups on sent emails, and stop them. Everything previews first and waits for your yes.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Which account is sending, whether the scheduler runs, last run

tools.name: delete_sequence
tools.description: Delete a saved sequence (preview, then confirm)

tools.name: save_sequence
tools.description: Create or edit a reusable follow-up sequence, with attachments

tools.name: list_sent_threads
tools.description: Recent sent emails to follow up on

tools.name: start_sequence_on_thread
tools.description: Schedule a sequence on a sent email (preview, then confirm)

tools.name: send_campaign
tools.description: Send a first email and follow-ups (preview, then confirm)

tools.name: stop_campaign
tools.description: Cancel follow-ups on a thread (preview, then confirm)
